label: For "Gas Network Leak Detection": Detect gas leaks along pipelines and in the distribution network from sensors, mobile survey data and pressure behaviour so repair crews are sent to the highest-risk leaks first. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Counting leaks equally.
